F1.Chat UI: Renders the streamed answer and the inline cited passages.
F1.Conversation Service: Creates the session and stores the Q/A turn the answer belongs to.
F1.Orchestrator: Runs the turn loop and calls Claude with retrieved context.
F1.Retriever: Hybrid search returning top-k chunks as citable documents.
F1.Prompt Registry: Versioned system prompt that demands citation-backed answers.
F1.Vector Index: HNSW index on chunk vectors is store-specific work that only serving needs (added after reading the sets, see keyChanges).

F2.Chat UI: Confirmation step before the side-effecting tool runs.
F2.Orchestrator: Executes the returned create_it_ticket call through the Tool Gateway.
F2.Tool Gateway: Schema, input validation, allow-list and confirmation requirement for create_it_ticket.
F2.Ticket Tool Adapter: Maps the call to a ServiceNow incident and returns the number.
F2.Prompt Registry: Tool list is versioned here; the new tool must be added ahead of the cache breakpoint.

F3.Source Connector: Scheduled pull of added/changed/deleted files, one ingest message per file.
F3.Document Parser & Chunker: Parses and chunks each new or changed file.
F3.Embedding Indexer: Upserts chunks and deletes chunks of removed files.
F3.Vector Index: Tombstone handling for deleted files is store-specific.
F3.Document Blob Store: New bucket plus 30-day lifecycle rule on parsed intermediates is store-specific.

F4.Feedback Widget: Captures the thumbs-down and reason, posts to the API.
F4.Conversation Service: Stores feedback against the message and exposes flagged conversations to reviewers, a new read beyond owner-only.
F4.Eval Dashboard: Review queue UI with the promote action.
F4.Eval Runner: Owns the golden question set a promoted item is added to.

F5.Source Connector: Pulls each file's ACLs with the file.
F5.Embedding Indexer: Writes ACLs onto the chunks it upserts.
F5.Vector Index: ACL array column plus GIN index is store-specific.
F5.Retriever: Filters results by the caller's ACLs before reranking.

F6.Eval Runner: Weekly schedule, Slack report and threshold alert all sit on the runner that already scores and alerts.

keyChanges: F1: added Vector Index. Both sets linked the HNSW index to F1; on reflection the HNSW index exists for serving-side search speed, not for ingestion, so it is store-specific work that F1 owns. F3 keeps its own Vector Index link for tombstone handling.

wrong: Guardrail Filter — injection screening and grounding check are cross-cutting quality controls the feature passes through, not work the feature requires or changes.
Document Parser & Chunker — page-referenced chunking is ingestion work; X already links it under F3, so this double-counts.
Eval Runner — golden questions for the feature are eval coverage, not a component that must be built for the client feature to work.
Guardrail Filter — input screening already runs on every turn; F2 does not change it.
Eval Runner — same eval-coverage reasoning as F1; not a build dependency of the ticket feature.

missing: Document Blob Store — new bucket for raw files and parsed text with the 30-day lifecycle rule is store-specific work the sync needs.

wrong: Source Manager — F3 is the unattended sync ('without anyone pressing a button'); connecting a library and showing last-sync status is admin setup that is not part of this feature. Borderline: no listed feature covers library connection, so this is defensible, but it does not belong under F3.
Guardrail Filter — the grounding check verifies answer support, not document permissions; the why stretches §6 Responsibility to make it fit an ACL feature.

patterns: X links Eval Runner to user-facing features (F1, F2) as 'golden questions cover this' — eval coverage is treated as a build dependency when it is not.
X links Guardrail Filter to features that merely pass through it (F1, F2); Y does the same once on F5 with a stretched why about ACL-filtered grounding.
X pulls ingestion-side components (Document Parser & Chunker) under the serving feature F1, double-counting work it already linked in F3.
X misses store-specific Blob Store work (new bucket + lifecycle rule) in F3 while correctly linking Vector Index tombstones — inconsistent application of the store-link convention.
Y links an admin UI (Source Manager) to an unattended-sync feature that explicitly excludes manual triggering; borderline since no listed feature covers library connection.
Both sets correctly put the HNSW index under F1 and the ACL column/GIN index under F5, which moved the judge's key on F1.
